instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: Having an ((accident)) is very dangerous for motorcyclists.
atoms.finishSound: Having an accident is very dangerous for motorcyclists.

atoms.b: You can make plenty of different meals using ((potatoes)).
atoms.finishSound: You can make plenty of different meals using potatoes.

atoms.b: The emperor came to the amphitheatre for a special ((occasion)).
atoms.finishSound: The emperor came to the amphitheatre for a special occasion.

atoms.b: She climbed to the top using her last bit of ((strength)).
atoms.finishSound: She climbed to the top using her last bit of strength.
He felt surprise first, then pain.

atoms.b: It was his first ((experience)) with a car ride.
atoms.finishSound: It was his first experience with a car ride.
